picks.sceneDesc: Library, dorm, commute — tested for ANC, battery, comfort & price. We bought 12 models with our own money and tested each for 20+ hours in real study environments.
picks.methodology: We evaluate ANC depth (tested in 70dB cafe noise), battery life (real-world with ANC on), multipoint connectivity stability, codec support (LDAC/AAC/SBC), and comfort over 3-hour sessions. Prices tracked daily via Amazon PA-API and Impact. Products scoring below 7/10 on ANC or comfort are excluded regardless of price.

picks.sceneTitle: Best Dorm-Friendly Appliances for International Students
picks.sceneDesc: Dual-voltage, compact, dorm-allowed, survive voltage swings abroad. We tested 15 small appliances across 3 continents (US/UK/Asia) in real dorm conditions.
picks.methodology: Must support 100-240V auto-switching (no manual switch), under 500W for dorm circuit limits, UL/CE certified, fit in carry-on luggage. Tested for: voltage stability at 90V/250V, actual power draw, noise level, and durability over 30-day continuous use. Any product requiring voltage converter is auto-excluded.

picks.sceneTitle: Best Focus Gear for Exam Season (IELTS/TOEFL/AP/IB)
picks.sceneDesc: Noise reduction, pomodoro timers, eye comfort — gear that helps you study longer without burnout. Tested during actual exam prep cycles with 20+ students.
picks.methodology: Earplugs tested for SNR (single number rating) and comfort during 4-hour mock exams. Timers evaluated for zero-screen distraction, tactile feedback, and battery life. Lamps measured for flicker (IEEE 1789), blue light hazard (RG0), and illuminance at 50cm. All products used daily for 2+ weeks during live exam periods.
